entries.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. WorldEngine Style B rich stylized renderer paint-over, not photorealism. Image 1 is the EXACT EDIT TARGET and authority for house detail, camera, composition, footprints, floor counts, roof shapes, window/door positions, stoops, cornices and scene layout. Image 2 is the shared DENVER HERO LIGHTING/COLOR anchor; match its blue sky, neutral paving, filled shadow balance and exposure exactly. It is NOT a geometry reference; do not copy its dog, houses, objects, autumn coverage or layout.
Change illumination and color balance ONLY to this single shared mid-afternoon hero state:
Sky BLUE with soft white clouds: zenith #73A5CC, mid #A2C4DC, low horizon #DBDCD1. Subtle warmth only very near horizon. NO PURPLE/PINK/LAVENDER sky or haze. Warm soft sunlight #FFE8C6, but NOT orange/yellow gilding. Soft-edged short/moderate mid-afternoon shadows with cool NEUTRAL blue-gray appearance #7F8F99, not purple. Natural directional surface illumination, no bright yellow rim outlines along house roofs, trim, cornices or windows. Keep trim cream, brick warm masonry, window inset darkness and architectural details from image 1 absolutely; do not redesign houses.
Ground neutral GREY asphalt #626A70, light warm-GREY concrete #C5C0B3, natural muted lawn green #73865B. Concrete is light grey rather than blue or tan; asphalt stays neutral grey even in shadow. No global lavender, sepia or orange cast. No HDR edge glow, no blown highlights, no atmospheric fog. Use clear-day filled shadows, real gentle material shading. Same overall exposure and color target across all four pack views.
One illustrative world sun elevation 40 degrees, azimuth 225 degrees clockwise from true north. Camera is locked; shade surfaces consistently rather than placing a visible sun disk. Source image does not establish surveyed compass orientation, so do not claim ephemeris-verified shadows.
Keep Style B broad simplified 3D forms and existing material detail, not photographic textures. No logos, lettering, house numbers, people, watermark or labels. Full-frame image, same composition/aspect, no panels or camera changes.
LAKEVIEW SIDEWALK: Relight the existing house paint-over, no architectural reconstruction. Preserve the central occluding trunk, crowns' silhouettes, shrubs and layout; correct their light/hue to natural greens and grey-brown bark rather than yellow highlights. Do not add objects.
Keep ground as broad simple tonal planes; NO individual grass blades, photographic bark/brick/asphalt texture, or stippled noise. Keep roof/window/cornice details entirely unchanged.

postcardCorrection.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the postcard HERO draft to correct, image 2 is DENVER shared lighting anchor.
Single targeted correction, NOT a new design: keep the blue sky, neutral road/concrete, soft neutral shadows and every house detail/camera/composition in image 1 unchanged. Keep the three generic cars, lamps, square tree pits, grey-brown trunks and the existing tree positions.
Simplify the postcard trees to match image 2's rich stylized geometry: replace dense individually drawn leaves with 5–9 unequal interlocking broad smooth crown lobes per tree, varied irregular silhouettes and a few clear sky holes, soft continuous light/shadow over lobes. No smooth identical spheres, no individual leaf silhouettes/leaf texture or photo bark. Natural muted mixed greens with small early-autumn touches, not lime or orange overall. Preserve approximate crown envelopes, trunk positions and branch clearance.
Also reduce tiny noisy road/grass/bark texture to broad clean stylized matte planes, without changing colors/exposure or shadows. Put the far dark-grey car firmly in a curbside parking position at the right curb rather than in the travel lane; keep the closer right cream car and left blue-grey car parked at their curbs, not on walkways. No brands/logos/people/readable number plates.
Do NOT change any house roof, cornice, trim, window openings, stoops, heights, placement or materials. No yellow edge light, purple colors, water, extra objects, labels or cropped composition. All four views must share image 2's calm mid-afternoon color and lighting.
